evals.prompt: Thêm hiệu ứng cho section image-with-text: tiêu đề tách chữ trồi lên, ảnh hover kiểu goo sang ảnh thứ hai (merchant chọn ảnh thứ hai trong settings), tôn trọng reduced motion.
evals.expected_output: Uses xo-motion (not xo-animate): section prelude with motion_tag bridging settings.animate_disabled; heading with text-rise / text-rise-words on an inline_richtext heading; image frame as an xo-trigger="hover" host with xo-motion-gl="goo" over two image_tag outputs carrying crossorigin: 'anonymous', the second inside {% if section.settings.image_2 %} with a one-image fallback; GL not on the first-section LCP image; notes reduced motion (end state, no canvas, CSS crossfade fallback) and touch (hover is a bonus); mentions xo-motion-gl.lazy.min.js asset; runs validate-liquid.py.
assertions: Uses xo-motion for the new motion
Adds no new xo-animate / xo-parallax markup
Heading is split text rising (text-rise* or xo-split)
Image hover uses in-frame GL goo on a hover host
Second image is a merchant setting (image_picker)
Reduced motion is handled or documented
Mentions the motion-gl lazy chunk asset

evals.prompt: Build a pinned horizontal lookbook section where cards flare at the edges like liquid while scrolling (smear), merchant picks images in blocks.
evals.expected_output: A tall xo-motion xo-scrub room (xo-start="top top" xo-end="bottom bottom") with a sticky 100svh stage, an overflow-x: clip frame and a row translated by a measured expression; each block card is frameless (capsule / rounded radius) with xo-motion-gl="smear" and options { strength: 'speed', frame: '<clip selector>', lens: ~0.02-0.05 }; images via image_tag with crossorigin: 'anonymous' and no loading=lazy; {{ block.shopify_attributes }} on each card; room height scales with block count; text below the card or faded before the rim; static fallback under prefers-reduced-motion and html[xo-animate-disabled]; schema caps max_blocks; mentions the motion-gl lazy chunk and verification (validate-schema/validate-liquid, browser, editor-qa).
assertions: Adds no new xo-parallax / xo-animate markup

evals.prompt: Section testimonials carousel: thẻ giữa to dần khi kéo, chữ quote trồi lên khi slide active. Có autoplay.
evals.expected_output: xo-carousel with xo-position-vars, xo-per-view="1", xo-overflow="visible", xo-loop and xo-carousel-trigger cards; CSS centre-big recipe driven by --xo-slide-offset (cards built at the big size, transform scale + translateX keeping gaps equal, pre-init fallback for the first slide); per-slide <xo-motion xo-trigger="parent"> with text-rise-lines on the quote (copy visibility tied to the centre card); visible keyboard-reachable pause button using the existing sections.slideshow.pause_slideshow / play_slideshow translations (WCAG 2.2.2), noting carousel autoplay already stops under reduced motion; notes xo-carousel-trigger needs xo-extras.lazy.min.js and a V1.9.29 bundle; motion_tag bridge for the global animation switch.
